title: The small-model bound omits occurring constants in the original vocabulary.
details: Theorem 2.1, printed p.3, states the bound max(1,m), with m the number of existential quantifiers, for relational vocabularies that have not yet excluded constants. The sentence c₁ ≠ c₂ has m=0 and a model, but no one-element model. The proof on p.4 first eliminates constants, increasing the existential prefix; its resulting bound therefore concerns the transformed sentence. For the original signature the corrected bound is max(1,m+c), where c is the number of occurring constants. The corpus proves this by retaining all witnesses and constant values, adding one point only if the resulting set is empty. No upstream correction is inferred.
